title: Trebol raises a round to modernize business onboarding
summary: For too long business onboarding has been done manually but we are working around the clock to revamp and accelerate the business verification process. We are proud of having clients that include banks, unicorns, and traditional companies. We are happy to announce that Trebol has raised a $3 million round to modernize the business onboarding process for banks, lenders, insurers, and compliance officers in Latin America.
body_text: Trébol Secures $3 Million to Help Banks and Lenders in Latin America Automate the Verification Process for Businesses MEXICO, May 24, 2023 – Trébol , a startup that seamlessly automates business identity verification and underwriting decisions, has secured $3 million in seed funding to help modernize how companies in Latin America are onboarded. Trébol’s infrastructure is revamping how banks, lenders, and compliance officers onboard their business customers by automating traditional pen-and-paper processes. With Trebol’s technology, banks and lenders can quickly access must-have data from reliable sources such as formation documents, tax records, proof of address, and more to onboard a business safely. In today’s market, banks can easily verify a consumer's identity by asking for a few pieces of information, allowing customers to open new financial products almost instantly. When it comes to verifying the identity of a business, the process can take weeks, particularly across Latin America. It can also delay the opening of any accounts, a procedure Fabian Torres Becerra, CEO and co-founder of Trébol, is all too familiar with as a former financial industry executive and entrepreneur. Without this infrastructure, business owners have to fill out dozens of forms and go through a lengthy document-sharing process to access financial products and services. “Improving the process of verifying a business is more important than ever. Business owners have a lot on their plate and shouldn’t face yet another obstacle. On the other side, banks and lenders have to comply with increasing regulatory demands and have to run a thorough review for each new business customer. It’s a process that can take weeks and for many business owners every minute counts, especially when it comes to accessing financial services. This is why my co-founder, Luis Buitrago León, our team, and I are committed to changing this part of the industry,” said Torres, CEO and co-founder of Trébol. Torres and Buitrago, who met in college, said the idea to create Trébol came from their personal experiences and extensive market research. Before launching the company, Torres and Buitrago spoke to hundreds of financial institutions, and a common problem surfaced was the need to quickly and safely onboard businesses. “Our technology, which leverages artificial intelligence and data collection, has enabled us to automate the onboarding process for thousands of businesses across Mexico and Colombia. It’s a milestone we’re extremely proud of. We also recognize we’re just getting started which is why we’re working around the clock to expand our product and help millions of business owners,” said Buitrago, CTO and co-founder of Trébol. Since its inception, the company has automated the verification of more than 8,000 businesses for banks, lenders, and expense management platforms in Mexico and Colombia, allowing business owners to get approved for new bank accounts and credit cards in minutes, not weeks. Clara , the fastest growing business expense management platform in Latin America, can attest to Trébol’s technology capabilities. The company started using Trébol in 2022 and has had a positive experience onboarding businesses to its platform. “Trébol helped us reduce underwriting time by 25% from the get-go, and we expect to reach a 50% total time reduction once we are fully integrated and with Trébol’s constant improvements,” said Katherine Arangoitia, Credit Manager at Clara. Investors who participated in the raise believe Trébol’s technology has the potential to change the landscape and provide banks with a much-needed solution that’s been absent. “It’s astonishing to see that the process of verifying a business has remained unchanged, especially with all the innovations we have seen in the fintech industry. This is a critical component to ensure that businesses thrive in our ecosystem. We’re excited to partner with Fabian, Luis, and the Trébol team to improve one of the biggest barriers that exist today when verifying a business in Latin America,” said Jared Newman of Canaan Partners . Better Tomorrow Ventures who co-led the raise says Trébol is well-positioned to become the go-to solution for business onboarding across Latin America and beyond. “When we met Fabian and Luis, we were immediately impressed by their commitment and dedication to building a solution that’s essential for business owners, banks, and lenders. Trébol has identified a real problem when it comes to business verification in Latin America and they found a way to fix such a tedious process that’s been long overdue. We view this as a win-win for all parties involved,” said Sheel Mohnot, co-founder of Better Tomorrow Ventures. The funding round was led by Better Tomorrow Ventures and Canaan Partners along with participation from Y Combinator, SOMA Capital, Unpopular Ventures, and angel investors from Moons, Kala, and Doppler. Trébol plans to use the funding to expand the product into new markets and grow the team. Currently, the service is available in Mexico and Colombia. About Trébol Trébol seamlessly automates business identity verification and underwriting decisions allowing banks, lenders, and insurers to quickly onboard its customers. The company, which was founded in 2021, has automated the verification of more than 8,000 businesses for banks, lenders, and expense management platforms in Mexico and Colombia. Trébol also received an investment from Y Combinator and was part of the winter 2022 accelerator program. ‍

title: Hillman Leadership Recognizes Life-Saving Efforts of Bakersfield Employees Following Emergency Incident
summary: Hillman honored employees at its Shafter, California distribution center for saving a colleague’s life during a medical emergency.
body_text: Hillman Leadership Recognizes Life-Saving Efforts of Bakersfield Employees Following Emergency Incident Members of Hillman’s leadership team formally honored the life-saving actions of several employees during a recognition ceremony held Nov. 19 at Hillman’s distribution center at the Wonderful Logistics Center (WLC) in Shafter, California. The ceremony recognized the heroic response of team members who saved a colleague's life during a medical emergency on Sept. 22. When an employee collapsed and showed no signs of breathing, trained coworkers immediately sprang into action, calling 911, using an AED to deliver a shock to the employee’s heart, and continuing with CPR until paramedics arrived. Their quick and courageous efforts saved the employee’s life, who has since recovered and returned to work. Hillman leaders in attendance included Bob Davis – EVP, Global Supply Chain, Frank Stevens – VP, Central Operations, Rodrigo Lopez – VP, Global Logistics, and Ben Wilcox – Sr. Dir. Distribution. Davis opened the ceremony with remarks and later presented plaques and medals to each employee involved. The following team members were recognized: Jose Plascencia Diaz – First to respond, supported the employee’s heal Carlos Reyes – Ran to get additional help Samantha Files – Called 911 and coordinated actions via the operator Alberto Guzman – Administered AED shock and began CP Noelle Lozoya – Continued CPR compressions until paramedics arrived "First aid training is a requirement for a designated number of employees at each of Hillman’s distribution centers, but we always hope that training is never needed. Thanks to the courage and quick thinking of our team, a life was saved,” said Bob Davis, Executive Vice President of Hillman’s Global Supply Chain. “We are incredibly proud of these employees. This incident is a powerful reminder that emergencies can happen anywhere and preparedness saves lives." The employees’ first aid and CPR training was provided by The Wonderful Career Center (WCC), located across the street from Hillman’s facility. Hillman began partnering with The Wonderful Career Center for first aid training opportunities in 2025. Representatives from the WCC also attended the ceremony to honor the employees and celebrate the positive impact of this partnership. “The CPR/AED training is one of many high-quality and hands-on training available through the Wonderful Career Center to strengthen and upskill our local workforce,” said Cindy Palacios, Director of Technical Training at the WCC. “Seeing Hillman’s team use that training to save a colleague’s life is deeply meaningful to us, and we’re proud to partner with an employer that prioritizes safety, preparedness, and the wellbeing of its workforce.” The WCC offers free, cutting-edge training and professional development opportunities for Kern County residents driving economic mobility in the region. The WCC is centrally located within the Wonderful Logistics Center, a state-of-the-art industrial complex serving multiple Fortune 100 tenants, including The Hillman Group. The WLC connects the entire Western U.S., by operating with a cleaner, more sustainable, community-first approach than virtually any other logistics hub in the nation. About Hillman Hillman Solutions Corp. (“Hillman”) is a leading provider of hardware-related products and solutions to home improvement, hardware, and farm and fleet retailers across North America. Renowned for its commitment to customer service, Hillman has differentiated itself with its competitive moat built on direct-to-store shipping, a dedicated in-store sales and service team of over 1,200 professionals, and over 60 years of product and industry experience. Hillman’s extensive portfolio includes hardware solutions (fasteners, screws, nuts and bolts), protective solutions (work gloves, jobsite storage and protective gear), and robotic and digital solutions (key duplication and tag engraving). Leveraging its world-class distribution network, Hillman regularly earns vendor of the year recognition from top customers. For more information on Hillman, visit www.hillman.com . About The Wonderful Company’s Corporate Social Responsibility The Wonderful Company and its co-owners, Lynda and Stewart Resnick, have a long-standing commitment to investing in the communities where their employees live and work, especially in California’s Central Valley, home to 3,000 employees. The Resnicks, along with their foundations and The Wonderful Company, have invested more than $2.5 billion in education, health and wellness, community development, and sustainability initiatives across the Central Valley, Fiji, and the world. To learn more about The Wonderful Company, and its core values, visit csr.wonderful.com.

title: Perrigo Announces Quarterly Dividend
summary: Perrigo Company plc (NYSE: PRGO), a leading provider of consumer self-care products, today announced that its Board of Directors has approved a quarterly dividend of $0.29 per share, or $1.16 per...
body_text: Press Releases Perrigo Company is a leading provider of Consumer Self-Care Products and over-the-counter (OTC) health and wellness solutions that enhance individual well-being by empowering consumers to proactively prevent or treat conditions that can be self-managed. Learn More Press Releases Presentations Events and Webcasts Stock Information SEC Filings Perrigo Announces Quarterly Dividend PDF DUBLIN , July 30, 2026 / PRNewswire / -- Perrigo Company plc (NYSE: PRGO), a leading provider of consumer self-care products, today announced that its Board of Directors has approved a quarterly dividend of $0.29 per share, or $1.16 per share on an annualized basis. The cash dividend is payable on September 15, 2026, to shareholders of record on August 28, 2026. About Perrigo Perrigo Company plc is a leading pure-play self-care company with over a century of experience in providing high-quality health and wellness solutions to consumers primarily in North America and Europe. As a pioneer in the over-the-counter (OTC) self-care market, Perrigo offers trusted self-care solutions that can be used without the need for a prescription, ensuring accessibility and choice for consumers across molecules, dosage forms, and value tiers. Perrigo's unique business model leverages its complementary businesses, where cash-generative store brand private label offerings fuel investments for leading brands, including Opill ® , Mederma ® , Compeed ® , EllaOne ® , and Jungle Formula ® . For more information, visit www.perrigo.com . title: Affordable Tech Education: How to Launch Your IT or Cybersecurity Career Without Breaking the Bank
summary: Affordable Tech Education: Launch IT & Cybersecurity Careers Fast
body_text: Are you eager to change your career and break into the fast-growing world of IT or cybersecurity, but worried about the high cost of tech education? Whether you are a career changer, a veteran, or a tech enthusiast without a traditional degree, there are practical and affordable pathways to build in-demand tech skills and land a rewarding job. In this post, we explain how affordable tech education can help you launch or advance your IT or cybersecurity career, what makes training truly effective, and how hands-on, skills-focused programs like those at NGT Academy bridge the gap between ambition and opportunity. Affordable tech education enables adults to gain real-world skills in IT or cybersecurity without the financial burden of traditional degrees. With hands-on labs, mentorship, and direct job connections, you can prepare for high-demand roles and start a rewarding career, no matter your background. Why Affordable Tech Education Matters More Than Ever The demand for IT and cybersecurity professionals continues to soar. In Canada and globally, organizations are facing a shortage of skilled talent in network engineering, data analytics, and cybersecurity. Traditional university programs, while valuable, can be costly and time-consuming, putting them out of reach for many adults seeking a career change or advancement. Affordable tech education gives motivated learners a realistic entry point into these high-growth fields, focusing on practical skills and job readiness rather than theory alone. Barriers Faced by Career Changers and Non-Traditional Learners High tuition fees and living expenses with traditional degrees Long program durations that delay earning potential Limited flexibility for working adults or those with families Requirement for prior academic credentials Affordable, skills-based programs address these barriers by offering condensed, focused training that leads directly to employment in IT, networking, or cybersecurity. What Makes Tech Education Truly Affordable and Effective? Not all tech training is created equal. The best affordable tech education options combine accessibility with outcomes. Here’s what to look for: Skills-Based Curriculum: Emphasizes hands-on labs, real-world scenarios, and project-based learning—key to building job-ready skills. Mentorship and Career Coaching: Personalized guidance from industry professionals helps bridge the gap between training and employment. Flexible Learning: Online, part-time, or accelerated programs let you learn around your current commitments. Direct Job Connections: Training is linked to actual job opportunities, not just certification. Transparent Costs: Programs are clear about tuition, with options for scholarships, payment plans, or even fully-funded training. At NGT Academy, for example, our Network Engineer Program + Cybersecurity Accelerator is designed to be accessible and outcome-driven, providing live instruction, mentorship, and career support so you can move directly into high-demand roles. How Hands-On Training Boosts Your Job Prospects Employers in IT and cybersecurity value demonstrable skills over credentials alone. Programs that include hands-on labs, simulations, and real-world projects better prepare you for interviews and on-the-job challenges. For instance, the current trend in Canadian tech education—seen in university summer programs and internships—blends technical skill-building with soft skills such as teamwork, problem-solving, and communication. This approach is proven to enhance job readiness and long-term career success. What Skills Are Most in Demand? Network administration and troubleshooting Cybersecurity fundamentals and threat defense Data analysis and visualization Programming basics (Python, scripting) Incident response and digital forensics Project management and communication These skills are emphasized in both entry-level and advanced programs, enabling you to move from help desk roles to more specialized engineering or analyst positions. Is Affordable Tech Education Right for You? If you are motivated to work in IT or cybersecurity but lack the budget or time for a traditional degree, affordable tech education could be your best path forward. It is ideal for: Adults considering a career switch from unrelated fields Entry-level IT professionals aiming for promotions Veterans transitioning to civilian tech careers Individuals from underrepresented groups seeking equity in tech Structured, intensive programs like those at NGT Academy have helped thousands of learners transform their careers, with support from experienced mentors and direct connections to employers. Step-by-Step: How to Start Your IT or Cybersecurity Career Affordably Assess Your Goals: Identify which IT or cybersecurity roles match your interests and background. Review job postings to determine required skills. Choose the Right Program: Look for training that is skills-based, includes hands-on labs, and offers career support. Ensure the program is transparent about costs and outcomes. Apply and Prepare: Many programs have competitive admissions. Prepare by brushing up on basic computer literacy and researching core concepts in networking and cybersecurity. Engage Fully: Participate in labs, ask questions, and connect with your mentors. Build a portfolio of projects to showcase your abilities to employers. Leverage Career Services: Take advantage of resume reviews, interview coaching, and job placement support provided by your chosen program. Network and Stay Updated: Join professional groups, attend webinars, and continuously update your skills to remain competitive in the evolving tech landscape.
